The structure of Zr4Al4Fe8 (reduced formula ZrAlFe2) adopts the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Al and Zr each have eight Fe neighbors, while Fe has four Al and four Zr neighbors, all at 2.6368 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Fe-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Al- and Zr-centered polyhedra.
